title: Nematode telomerase RNA hitchhikes on introns of germline–up-regulated genes | Science
content: Telomerase is a ribonucleoprotein complex that elongates telomeric DNA, ensuring germline immortality. In this study, we identified the Caenorhabditis elegans telomerase RNA component 1 (terc-1), as the first known telomerase RNA expressed as an intronic ...
